highlights.title: U.N. Live Updates: Zelensky Warns of Growing Global Cost of Russia’s War in Ukraine
highlights.summary: Ukraine’s president said rising fuel prices and deadlier drone technology showed that years of fighting have spilled beyond his country’s borders. He called for steps to end to the war before winter.
